name: ai-crm-v2-web
description: AI-CRM v2 TypeScript frontend — admin console, WeCom sidebar and H5

scripts.version:check: node -e "const ua=process.env.npm_config_user_agent||'';if(process.version!=='v24.18.0'||!ua.startsWith('npm/11.12.1 ')){console.error('expected node v24.18.0 and npm 11.12.1');process.exit(1)}" && test "$(orval --version)" = "7.21.0" && test "$(prettier --version)" = "3.9.6"
scripts.performance:check: npm run build --silent && node web/scripts/reproducible-build.mjs && node web/scripts/performance-budget.mjs
scripts.e2e: npm run build --silent && node web/scripts/e2e.mjs && node web/scripts/profile-catalog-history-e2e.mjs && node web/scripts/hxc-history-e2e.mjs && node web/scripts/static-history-e2e.mjs && node web/scripts/customer-state-history-e2e.mjs && node web/scripts/marketing-state-history-e2e.mjs && node web/scripts/wecom-contact-history-e2e.mjs && node web/scripts/radar-marketing-history-e2e.mjs && node web/scripts/campaign-definition-history-e2e.mjs && node web/scripts/e2e_deferred_identity_history.mjs && node web/scripts/invalid-source-history-e2e.mjs && node web/scripts/audience-history-e2e.mjs && node web/scripts/automation-agents-e2e.mjs
scripts.test: npm run transport:contract && npm run admin:adapter:contract && npm run capabilities:contract && npm run ui:shell:contract && npm run smoke && npm run e2e
scripts.ci: npm run version:check && npm run orval:check && npm run orval:contract && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run performance:check && npm run edge:contract && npm run release:contract && npm run audit
